findings.evidence: CFSGStatement/README.md lines 211–214 order L0 before L1 and L3; CFSGStatement/STATUS.md lines 31 and 37 say non-type-A L0 remains incomplete and waits on ReductiveGroups Layer 9, while ReductiveGroups/STATUS.md line 29 says Layer 9 lacks a uniform pinned construction.
findings.fix: Defer this file until the minuscule carrier is identified with the pinned simply connected E₇ group, or include that identification and expose these results through the actual L0/L1 construction.
findings.issue: This builds Frobenius and fixed-point-quotient infrastructure for a carrier that cannot yet supply CFSG L0; the PR itself says transport requires the missing Layer 9 identification.

summary: The carrier computations have a genuine path to CFSG L1/L3, but they are premature because the required L0 pinned-carrier identification is absent.
